extracted.name: Holly's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Dip
extracted.description: Chocolate chip cookie dough dip is a new twist on dessert for any aged crowd. Dip graham crackers and vanilla wafer into this sweet chocolate treat.
instruction_lines: Beat together cream cheese, butter, confectioners' sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla in a large bowl with an electric mixer on medium-high speed until smooth and creamy.
Stir in chocolate chips until well combined.
Transfer cookie dough to a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
